legend.#: Outer/solid wall. Blocks walking and bullets.
legend.B: Building block (tall). Blocks walking and bullets.
legend.C: Crate (cargo crate model). Blocks walking and bullets.
legend.~: Blue zone floor (cosmetic tint; in some zones a marked area such as cover or a landing pad, said per zone).
legend.y: Hazard stripes (cosmetic; in zones that say so, a press or crusher footprint for STRIKE fixed mode).
legend.D: Blast door. Seals while its room is live, opens on clear or when its hack terminal finishes.
legend.H: Hack terminal for the nearest door (hold-to-interact, see INTERACT).
legend.L: Exit lift pad (one or more L cells form one pad). Stand on it for the extract timer (3 s).
legend.Z: Objective zone centre (HOLD ring, DEFEND drop point, UPLINK start). Ring radius is per objective.
legend.c: Hive creep (SPREAD layer, creep skin). Present at floor start; it can grow.
legend.m: Hive wall (HIVE_WALL): destructible, blocks walking and bullets, regrows.
legend.K: Breaker box (BREAKER): shoot it to switch off the floor's grates, fences or lights.
legend.^: Conveyor moving north, toward the top row (CONVEYOR).
legend.V: Conveyor moving south, toward the bottom row (CONVEYOR).
legend.k: Crumbling walkway (COLLAPSE): falls into a pit after it is stepped on.
legend._: Pit / void. Blocks walking, not bullets. Anything shoved in dies (PIT).
legend.J: Jump pad. Pads pair in reading order: 1st with 2nd, 3rd with 4th (JUMP_PAD).
legend.w: Shallow water (WATER). Becomes deep when the floor floods.
legend.u: Covered floor, a roof slab on posts (COVER). Shelter from ACID_RAIN and STRIKE.
legend.F: Flare cache (DARKNESS): walk over to refill flares to 3.
legend.I: Light pylon (DARKNESS): stand 1.5 s to light it, 7 m radius, stays lit.
legend.R: Objective terminal (INTERACT). The zone names it: relay, valve, pump, uplink, console.
legend.:: Payload track (ESCORT). The cart starts on Q and follows the ':' path.
legend.+: Med station: one use, +35 HP (same as the escape-room clear heal).
legend.f: Fire at floor start (SPREAD layer, fire skin).
legend.d: Dark floor: no ambient light in this cell even on lit floors (DARKNESS, partial).
legend.p: Flammable floor (carpet, wooden decking, cable trays). Walkable; fire (SPREAD fire skin) may spread onto it.
legend.h: Frost seed (SPREAD frost skin). Walkable; frost grows from it.

toolkit.name: Hold-to-interact terminal
toolkit.what: The existing door-hack terminal generalised: hack, relay, pump, valve, uplink, console, plant charge.
toolkit.trigger: Hero within 1.5 m. No button: standing in range fills the bar; leaving pauses it (keeps progress); taking a hit knocks 15% off.
toolkit.timing: Default 4.5 s (doors), relays 3 s, pumps/valves 3 s, charges 3 s. Auto-fire keeps working while interacting.
toolkit.damage: None. Each completion can fire a floor event (open doors, start a wave, turn on lights, drain water).
toolkit.visuals: Existing terminal + radial bar above the hero. Amber idle, cyan filling, green done. Completion: haptic tick + short sting.

toolkit.name: Hive nest
toolkit.what: The existing HUNT nest, made a general spawner.
toolkit.trigger: Active while the hero is within 14 m.
toolkit.timing: Spawns 1 Drone every 6 s (2 at difficulty 1.4+). A nest on a creep floor is also a creep seed.
toolkit.damage: Nest has 30 RH. Death: big purple goo burst, 6 biomass, scorches radius 2.
toolkit.counter: Auto-fire targets a nest only when no enemy is in range (same low-priority rule as eggs and pods).
toolkit.visuals: Current placeholder nest + goal icon. Pulses faster when about to spawn.

toolkit.name: Spread layer (creep, fire, flood, frost)
toolkit.what: One cellular system for anything that grows across the floor tile by tile. Creep, fire, flood water and frost are skins of it with different numbers.
toolkit.trigger: Seeds: cells drawn as c, f or h (frost), any NEST or HIVE_WALL (creep), SEED events (see Floor events), any NEST or HIVE_WALL (creep), FLOOD sources (w cells on a flooding floor), boss abilities. Each live seed has a frontier.
toolkit.timing: Every tick (creep 2.5 s, fire 1.5 s, flood 1.0 s, frost 3 s) each seed converts one random walkable neighbour of its frontier. Cap per floor (default 40% of walkable cells) so it never eats the whole map.
toolkit.damage: Creep: hero -35% move speed; enemies on creep +15% speed and regenerate 2% max HP/s. Fire: 12 HP/s to hero, 2 RH/s to enemies, spreads only onto creep, crates (C, which burn for 10 s and then become floor) and flammable floor (p). Flood: see WATER. Frost: hero -25% speed and -20% fire rate while standing on it.
toolkit.counter: Burning creep: every cell the hero DASHES through is scorched; explosions (barrels, Grenade card, Bloater bursts) scorch radius 2 cells; Shock Trail card scorches cells it touches; Incendiary Rounds (power-up in enemies-and-powerups.md) scorch every creep cell their bullets cross. A scorched cell cannot regrow for 20 s. Killing the seed (nest, hive wall) stops its frontier; its cells then recede 1 per 3 s.
toolkit.visuals: Per-cell floor decal quad 2 m, grown from scale 0 to 1 over 0.4 s. Creep: near-black purple #2a0f33 with pulsing emissive veins #b04dff (sin 1.2 Hz). Fire: existing muzzle-flame and smoke particles on a 1 m grid, orange point light every 3rd cell. Flood: translucent quad #2a5d7a, alpha 0.55, slow UV scroll. Frost: white #e8f6ff decal with blue rim. Scorched: #1a1a1a decal with a few spark particles on creation.
toolkit.perf: Store as a byte per cell; decals are one instanced mesh per skin. Rebuild the flow-field cost only when a cell changes.

toolkit.name: Darkness, flares and light pylons
toolkit.what: Floors where the lights are out. You see and shoot only inside light.
toolkit.trigger: Floor flag dark=true (or d cells on a lit floor).
toolkit.timing: Flares: right-thumb FLARE button appears, 3 charges, throw lands 5 m ahead of movement direction, burns 12 s. A flare landing within 1 m of an enemy sticks to it and moves with it. Pylons (I): stand 1.5 s to light, permanent. Breaker (K) or relay can relight a whole floor.
toolkit.damage: Enemies in flare or pylon light take +20% damage (they are 'exposed').
toolkit.counter: Hero carries a 5.5 m radius light. Auto-fire range is capped to the lit area around each target (an enemy must be lit to be targeted). Unlit enemies show only two red eye glints.
toolkit.visuals: Directional light to 8%, ambient to 10%, fog black. Hero: point light 5.5 m, cool white. Flare: red-orange point light 7 m, flicker, smoke trail and sparks (existing). Pylon: white point light 7 m + blue cylinder glow. Eye glints: 2 tiny emissive red spheres on every enemy prefab, always visible.
toolkit.perf: Max 8 dynamic lights; pylons beyond 8 bake to emissive only. Hide enemy meshes rather than cull logic.

toolkit.name: Timed vents
toolkit.what: Floor vents that erupt on a cycle: steam, cryo gas, slag gas, toxic gas.
toolkit.trigger: Always cycling. Vents are grouped by column parity so they pulse in two alternating groups (readable rhythm).
toolkit.timing: 6 s cycle: 3.3 s idle, 1.2 s warning (wisps, hiss, orange ring), 1.5 s eruption.
toolkit.damage: Eruption radius 1.5 m: hero 18 HP per 0.5 s tick; enemies 4 RH/s. Cryo skin: no damage, freezes hero for 0.8 s (enemies 2 s, frozen enemies take +50% damage).
toolkit.counter: Lure enemies through the column; Drones path straight through vents.
toolkit.visuals: Dark grate decal; eruption = smoke particles stretched into a 4 m column + point light (orange steam, pale blue cryo, green toxic).

toolkit.name: Pits and shove kills
toolkit.what: Holes that block walking but not bullets. Anything shoved or blown in dies, which makes Shove, shotgun, Breacher and explosions positional weapons.
toolkit.trigger: Enemy centre over a pit cell after a shove/knockback/gust.
toolkit.damage: Enemy: instant kill, full biomass. Bosses and mini-bosses never fall: pushed within 1 m of a pit lip they teeter (hang on the ledge) for 3 s and take double damage. Hero cannot fall in by walking; a dash ends at the pit edge; wind gusts or knockback can push him in: he respawns on the last safe cell with -25 HP and 1 s invulnerability.
toolkit.counter: Leapers can pounce across pits up to 3 cells; Drones path around.
toolkit.visuals: Black void quad 1 m below floor with a faint red uplight and edge hazard stripe trim.

toolkit.name: Egg clusters
toolkit.what: Field of eggs that hatch into Drones when the hero gets close, or all at once on a timer. Shooting them first is the counterplay.
toolkit.trigger: Proximity: hero within 3.5 m for 1.0 s (eggs wobble and hiss as the telegraph). Timed: a floor can call HATCH_ALL at a time, with a 3 s wobble on every egg.
toolkit.timing: Hatch: 3 Drones per cluster (2 mini Drones on floors 1-2).
toolkit.damage: Cluster has 2 RH. Destroyed = 1 biomass, no spawn.
toolkit.counter: Low-priority auto-fire target (only when no enemy is in range). Explosions and Shock Trail destroy them.
toolkit.visuals: 3-5 Drone-coloured spheres (scaled 0.4-0.6 m) with the Bloater pus material, idle pulse. Hatch: purple goo burst reused from Drone death.

toolkit.name: Telegraphed strike
toolkit.what: One system for everything that falls or hits a marked circle: cave-in rocks, crane containers, lightning, artillery, ceiling collapse, acid globs.
toolkit.trigger: Random mode (default): every N s (default 7 s) place K circles (default K = 3): half (rounded up) centred on a random point within 3 m of the hero, the rest on random walkable cells at least 4 m from each other. Fixed mode: circles on listed cells on a fixed beat (Kessler presses on every 'y' cell every 4 s, alternating halves).
toolkit.timing: Red ground circle grows for 1.5 s (1.0 s at Nightmare), then the hit.
toolkit.damage: 35 HP to hero, 12 RH to enemies, radius 2 m. Option 'leaves' (default 'none'): a crate C (container), rubble that acts as C for 15 s, or a fire seed.
toolkit.counter: Move out. COVER (u) cells block lightning and acid globs but not rocks or containers.
toolkit.visuals: Existing red Leaper floor-arrow material drawn as a ring. Hit: dust/spark/shake from the blast-door slam, plus a falling crate model (containers) or a grey cube (rock). Lightning: 0.1 s white stretched quad from sky + bright flash.

toolkit.name: Capturable turret
toolkit.what: Neutral auto-turret the hero can take over; it then becomes the swarm's favourite target.
toolkit.trigger: Stand within 1.5 m for 2.5 s (INTERACT rules).
toolkit.timing: Fires for 25 s or until destroyed, then 15 s cooldown before it can be captured again.
toolkit.damage: 12 m range, 6 shots/s, 1 RH per shot. Turret has 200 HP in hero-damage units (it soaks what the swarm would deal to you); enemies within 10 m switch to attacking it 50% of the time.
toolkit.visuals: Barrel-sized dark box with the AR rifle model at 1.6x on a yaw pivot, existing tracers and muzzle flash. Ring under it: grey neutral, cyan owned, red cooling.

toolkit.name: Hive walls
toolkit.what: Organic walls that block movement and bullets, can be shot down to open a shortcut or a firing line, and grow back.
toolkit.trigger: Destroyed after 10 RH. Low-priority auto-fire target.
toolkit.timing: Regrows 12 s after it dies (first 4 s as creep, then a 0.6 s grow-up). Does not regrow while the hero is standing on the cell.
toolkit.counter: Explosions deal triple damage to hive walls.
toolkit.visuals: B-sized block with the creep material and a slow breathing scale (1.0-1.03). Death: goo burst + chunks.
toolkit.perf: Same flow-field rebuild trigger as SPREAD.

toolkit.name: Electrified grates
toolkit.what: Floor grates that pulse with current. Live-wire tiles in flooded zones use the same timing.
toolkit.trigger: Cycling. A BREAKER (K, 5 RH, low-priority target) switches its target system off for good. What a breaker kills is data: the floor's 'breaker' field (GRATE, LASER_FENCE, LIGHTS or ALL). Default: whichever of GRATE / LASER_FENCE the layout has; a layout with both must set it.
toolkit.timing: 4 s off, 0.8 s warning (blue sparks), 1.6 s on.
toolkit.damage: Hero: 15 HP + 0.5 s stun on contact while on. Enemies: 6 RH/s while on, so a grate is a killing floor to lure the swarm across.
toolkit.counter: If a grate touches WATER cells, current spreads through connected water while on (same damage).
toolkit.visuals: Steel-grey grate decal; on = bright cyan #5fd8ff emissive + spark particles + crackle; warning = flicker.

toolkit.name: Spore pods
toolkit.what: Pods that puff clouds which hide enemies and choke your aim.
toolkit.trigger: Puffs every 15 s, and immediately when destroyed. The pod itself is the Spore Pod enemy in enemies-and-powerups.md (use its HP and art); this entry is the map-placed version and its cloud rules.
toolkit.timing: Cloud radius 4 m, lasts 8 s.
toolkit.damage: Enemies inside a cloud are hidden (only eye glints) and untargetable from outside it. Hero inside: auto-fire range halved.
toolkit.counter: Grenade card / explosions clear a cloud instantly.
toolkit.visuals: Green-yellow fog particles (smoke recoloured #a8c94a, alpha 0.5), soft volumetric look.

toolkit.name: Jump pads
toolkit.what: Pads that throw the hero to a paired pad: mobility between split levels, cargo lifts.
toolkit.trigger: Hero steps on a pad (enemies ignore pads; Leapers can follow by pouncing).
toolkit.timing: 0.8 s arc, invulnerable in flight, 2 s pad cooldown.
toolkit.damage: Landing shoves enemies within 2 m outward by 3 m (counts as a shove: pits and slag kill).
toolkit.visuals: Yellow-black ring decal with upward arrow particles; arc trail.

toolkit.name: Advancing front
toolkit.what: A wall of doom that sweeps across the map (flood surge, creep tide, collapse, reactor fire). Used by OUTRUN.
toolkit.trigger: Floor flag front with direction and speed.
toolkit.timing: Starts after a 5 s countdown, moves at 1.0-1.6 m/s, pauses 4 s when a terminal on its path is completed. 'On its path' = any R cell the front has not yet swept; each terminal pauses it once. Terminals already swept are lost.
toolkit.damage: Behind the front: 25 HP/s. Enemies caught behind it are not hurt (they ride it), so they arrive with it.
toolkit.counter: Keep moving; terminals buy time.
toolkit.visuals: Skins: flood / creep / fire use that SPREAD skin filled solid, with a bright leading-edge line and a matching particle curtain. Collapse skin: every swept cell plays the COLLAPSE fall (cracks 0.3 s, drop, fade) and becomes PIT; dust curtain (smoke particles, grey #8a8378) along the edge, camera shake 0.05 continuous, low rumble.

toolkit.name: Crumbling walkways
toolkit.what: Floor that gives way after you cross it. Routes close behind you; it also drops whatever is chasing you.
toolkit.trigger: Hero steps on a k cell (enemies do not trigger it).
toolkit.timing: Cracks for 1.0 s (dust, shake 0.1), then falls and becomes a PIT. Enemies on it at the moment it falls die. Scripted variant: a boss or floor event can collapse a set of k cells itself (Broodmother phase 4).
toolkit.counter: Plan the route; dash over.
toolkit.visuals: Floor plates with visible cracks texture; falling cell drops with gravity and fades.

toolkit.name: Wind gusts
toolkit.what: Periodic gusts that push everything one way. Near pits it is lethal for the swarm and dangerous for you.
toolkit.trigger: Floor flag wind.
toolkit.timing: Every 12 s: 2 s warning (HUD arrow and streak particles), then 3 s gust.
toolkit.damage: Push 4 m/s in the shown direction (one of 4). Dash cancels the push for its duration.
toolkit.counter: Stand behind B/C blocks (wind shadow 2 cells).
toolkit.visuals: Horizontal streak particles across the camera, fog drift.

toolkit.name: Cover roofs
toolkit.what: Roof slabs on posts that shelter from ACID_RAIN, lightning and acid globs.
toolkit.trigger: Hero (or enemy) centre inside a u cell.
toolkit.damage: Immune to ACID_RAIN and lightning STRIKE while under.
toolkit.visuals: Thin box 2x2 m at 3.2 m height on 4 thin posts, semi-transparent (alpha 0.35) when the hero is under it so the camera still sees the hero.

toolkit.name: Conveyor belts
toolkit.what: Floors that carry everything on them, for herding the swarm and for fast routes.
toolkit.trigger: Always on, unless a floor event or terminal reverses or stops them.
toolkit.timing: Belt speed 3 m/s added to movement. Reversal: chevrons flash 1.5 s before.
toolkit.counter: Belts that end in SLAG, PIT or a press (STRIKE fixed position) are kill lanes.
toolkit.visuals: Dark rubber #2b2b2e with yellow chevrons, UV scroll at belt speed. Side rollers as thin grey cylinders.
toolkit.perf: UV scroll only; one material per direction.

toolkit.name: Water and flooding
toolkit.what: Shallow water slows; flooding floors raise it and spread it.
toolkit.trigger: w cells are shallow at start. A flooding floor turns w cells into flood seeds (SPREAD flood skin) at set times.
toolkit.timing: Flood pulse every 20 s spreads for 8 s. A pump terminal (R) drains 25% of flooded cells over 3 s.
toolkit.damage: Shallow: hero -20% speed. Deep (flooded twice): hero -45% speed, Drones -30%, Leapers cannot pounce out of deep water. Electrified by GRATE/live cable: 15 HP + stun per pulse.
toolkit.counter: Dash is not slowed by water.
toolkit.visuals: Translucent #2a5d7a quad at +0.05 m (shallow) / +0.4 m (deep), gentle normal scroll, ripple particles at hero feet.

toolkit.name: Acid pools
toolkit.what: Static acid. Spitter puddles (enemies doc) use the same component with a lifetime.
toolkit.trigger: Unit centre on an a cell.
toolkit.damage: Hero 10 HP/s. Enemies immune.
toolkit.visuals: Toxic green #7cff3a emissive quad, bubbling particles.

toolkit.name: Laser fences
toolkit.what: Barriers that block walking and bullets while on. Turns open rooms into timed corridors.
toolkit.trigger: Cycling, or driven by a terminal/breaker.
toolkit.timing: 5 s on, 3 s off, 1 s flicker warning before switching on.
toolkit.damage: Touching while on: 25 HP and a 3 m shove. Enemies: 8 RH and shove.
toolkit.counter: A breaker K switches fences off when the floor's 'breaker' field is LASER_FENCE or ALL (see GRATE).
toolkit.visuals: Two short posts + a thin emissive plane #ff3355 (enemy-faction) or #55ccff (neutral), alpha 0.6, hum sound.

toolkit.name: Acid rain pulses
toolkit.what: The briefing's existing 'Acid Rain' modifier made real.
toolkit.trigger: Floor flag acid_rain.
toolkit.timing: Every 20 s: 3 s warning (sky tints green, siren, HUD icon), then 4 s of rain.
toolkit.damage: Hero outside COVER: 6 HP per 0.5 s. Enemies outside cover: 4% max HP per 0.5 s (rain thins the swarm too).
toolkit.counter: COVER cells.
toolkit.visuals: Green-tinted directional light lerp; rain streak particles on a camera-following emitter; puddle sparkle decals.
toolkit.perf: Rain emitter attached to camera, 600 particles max.

toolkit.name: Ice sheets
toolkit.what: Slippery floor. Momentum carries; enemies slide too.
toolkit.trigger: Unit centre on an i cell.
toolkit.damage: Hero acceleration and braking x0.25 (top speed unchanged). Drones and Leapers overshoot turns (same rule). Leaper pounce on ice slides an extra 3 m.
toolkit.counter: Dash is the best way to stop.
toolkit.visuals: Pale blue #cfe9f7 decal, high smoothness, faint reflection of lights.

toolkit.name: Slag channels
toolkit.what: Molten channels. The swarm routes around them; you can shove it in.
toolkit.trigger: Unit centre on a * cell.
toolkit.damage: Hero: 30 HP/s and ignited for 2 s (6 HP/s). Enemy: dies in 0.5 s (counts as a kill, full biomass). The flow field treats slag as blocked so enemies path around unless shoved.
toolkit.counter: Shove, explosions, conveyors into slag.
toolkit.visuals: Emissive orange #ff6a1a quad with slow UV scroll, ember particles, orange point light every 4th cell.

toolkit.name: Radiation
toolkit.what: Areas you can pass through but not camp in.
toolkit.trigger: Hero on a q cell.
toolkit.timing: RAD meter +12%/s on q, decays 8%/s off it.
toolkit.damage: At 100% RAD: 5 HP/s until below 60%. Enemies on q gain +20% damage (they glow).
toolkit.counter: A valve/console terminal (R) can purge one region of q cells.
toolkit.visuals: Sickly yellow-green #c8ff3a floor glow, floating dust particles, Geiger click rising with the meter. RAD bar under the HP bar.

toolkit.name: Tilted floor drift
toolkit.what: The whole floor slopes (crashed ship): everything slides slowly downhill.
toolkit.trigger: Floor flag drift with a direction.
toolkit.timing: Constant.
toolkit.damage: 1.2 m/s push. Barrels roll downhill and explode on contact with a wall or enemy.
toolkit.visuals: Tilt the camera 4 degrees and roll the scene's props; dust trickling downhill.

objectives.PURGE: Existing. Clear N waves (default 3). Floor ends when the last wave dies.
objectives.SURVIVE: Existing. Survive T seconds (default 45) while spawns ramp. Enemies alive at the end die in a shockwave.
objectives.ESCAPE: Existing. Chain of rooms: doors seal behind you, hack locked doors (H, 4.5 s), reach the lift L and hold it 3 s.
objectives.HOLD: Existing. Stay inside the upload ring (radius 3.5 m around Z) for a total of T s (default 30). Progress only counts while inside; pauses (never drains) outside.
objectives.BOSS: Existing. Kill the boss. The boss arena never has more than 1 objective.
objectives.UPLINK: New. HOLD with a moving ring: the ring (radius 3 m) relocates to the next Z every 10 s (warning arrow 2 s before). Total 30 s inside.
objectives.ESCORT: New. Payload cart on Q follows the ':' track at 1.5 m/s while the hero is within 4 m and no enemy is touching it; enemies attack it (cart 400 HP in hero-damage units, repaired 5 HP/s while it moves). Floor ends when it reaches the track end. Lose if destroyed. Variant 'torch cart' (Hive Core): the cart only moves on scorched or creep-free cells and burns 1 cell ahead of itself every 2 s.
objectives.SALVAGE: New. Pick up 5 of the data cores $ on the map (walk over). Each pickup triggers a small ambush (4-6 Drones from the nearest S). Then the lift L opens; stand 3 s.
objectives.DEFEND: New. Protect the generator G (600 HP in hero-damage units) for T s (default 45). Enemies prefer the generator 60% of the time. Lose if it dies.
objectives.DETONATE: New. Plant charges at every '!' (INTERACT 3 s each). On the last plant a 25 s countdown starts: reach the lift L. Blast kills everything still on the floor; the hero dies if not on the lift.
objectives.OUTRUN: New. An advancing FRONT chases you across the floor to the lift L. Terminals R on the way pause it 4 s. No wave count; enemies spawn ahead of you.
objectives.RELAY: New. Activate the relay terminals R in order (numbered by reading order, each 3 s). Each one completes a floor event (lights on, doors open, grates off). The last one ends the floor.
objectives.BURN: New. Scorch 80% of the creep on the floor (see SPREAD counters). Creep keeps growing from nests, so killing nests first is the smart route.
objectives.ASSASSINATE: New. A marked elite (named per zone, 4x HP, gold outline; uses the elite rules of enemies-and-powerups.md when present) flees from the hero to the far side of the map and summons escorts every 10 s. Kill it within 60 s for the bonus; floor ends when it dies.

blocking.move_and_shot: # B C m(until destroyed) X(until destroyed) G K T n
blocking.walkable: everything else: . ~ y P S D(when open) H L Z c f p h o e % g > < ^ V k J w a i u q F I R $ ! : Q + @ d
blocking.notes: Barrels X, generators G, breakers K, turrets T and nests n are 1-cell solid props. Pylons I, terminals R/H, caches F, eggs e, pods % and pads J are floor pads you stand on. Hive walls m are solid until shot down and spawn points must never depend on opening one. Slag * is walkable for the hero in rules but treated as solid for pathing and layout checks.

event_triggers.t: Seconds since floor start. Value: number.
event_triggers.every: Repeat. Value: {s: period, from: first time (default = s), until: last time (optional), times: max repeats (optional)}.
event_triggers.progress: Objective progress reached (0-1): HOLD/UPLINK time, SURVIVE time, ESCORT distance, BURN %, DEFEND time. Value: number.
event_triggers.wave: PURGE wave event. Value: {n: wave number, at: 'start' | 'end'}.
event_triggers.done: An objective step finished. Value: {kind: 'terminal' | 'relay' | 'pump' | 'charge' | 'nest' | 'pickup' | 'room' | 'door', index: n (1-based, reading order; omit = any), count: n (omit = each)}.
event_triggers.boss_hp: Boss HP fraction at or below. Value: number (phases also live in zone-bosses.json).
event_triggers.hero_hp: Hero HP fraction at or below. Value: number.
event_triggers.enter: Hero enters a marked area. Value: {cells: 'Z' | 'L' | letter, or room index}.

event_actions.SPAWN: Spawn enemies. params: {enemy, count, at: 'S' (all spawns) | 'nearest_S' | 'far_S' | 'ahead' | 'behind' | 'ring' (8 m around hero) | 'door' | letter, group: 'pack'|'spread'}.
event_actions.HATCH_ALL: Every egg cluster hatches. params: {wobble: s (default 3)}.
event_actions.SET: Override a mechanic's numbers for the rest of the floor (or for 'for' seconds). params: {system: toolkit id, ...fields, for: s}. Fields use the toolkit's names, e.g. {system: 'LASER_FENCE', on: 8, off: 2}, {system: 'TURRET', capture: 1.5}.
event_actions.TOGGLE: Switch a system. params: {system: toolkit id or 'LIGHTS' | 'DOORS', state: 'on' | 'off' | 'reverse' | 'cycle', warn: s}.
event_actions.STRIKE: Run a STRIKE burst or schedule. params: {mode: 'random' | 'fixed', count, radius, delay, leaves, cells: letter (fixed mode), interval (schedule), skin: 'rock'|'container'|'lightning'|'glob'|'press'}.
event_actions.SEED: Start or grow a SPREAD skin. params: {skin: 'creep'|'fire'|'flood'|'frost', at: letter | 'random' | 'hero', count, tick: s}.
event_actions.FRONT: Start, pause or change an advancing front. params: {skin, dir: 'N'|'S'|'E'|'W', speed: m/s, countdown: s, state: 'start'|'pause'|'stop'}.
event_actions.WEATHER: Global flag on/off. params: {system: 'ACID_RAIN' | 'WIND' | 'DRIFT', state, dir, period}.
event_actions.LIGHT: Lighting change. params: {level: 0-1 (ambient multiplier), area: 'all' | letter | room index, flash: s}.
event_actions.FOG: Fog change. params: {end_m, density_mult, for: s}.
event_actions.CAPTURE: Force a turret's owner. params: {target: 'T' index or 'all', owner: 'hero' | 'neutral' | 'enemy', for: s}.
event_actions.OPEN: Open, enable or reveal objects. params: {target: 'D' | 'L' | '+' | 'F' | 'R' | letter, index (optional)}.
event_actions.CLOSE: Seal or disable objects. params: {target, index}.
event_actions.DROP: Drop a pickup. params: {kind: power-up id | 'flare' | 'medgel', at: 'hero' | 'random' | letter}.
event_actions.MOVE_ZONE: Relocate the objective ring. params: {to: 'next_Z' | 'random_Z', warn: 2}.

event_param_rules: Params listed above are the contract. Zones also use a few optional extras: 'delay' (s before the action runs), 'only_if' (a condition string the game may ignore at first), 'aim' (target for a STRIKE or DROP), 'block_hp' (RH of a spawned blocker), 'rearm' (s before a terminal can be used again), 'area' ({cols:[a,b]} or {rows:[a,b]}), 'kind' ('card_offer' and similar), 'placement', 'sync'. Unknown params must be ignored, not treated as errors, so a zone can be built before every extra is supported.

tiers.name: Hard
tiers.rule: Zone cleared on Normal and Commander Rank 5. Elites from floor 2. The zone's first modifier is always on.

tiers.name: Nightmare
tiers.rule: Zone cleared on Hard and Commander Rank 10. Two fixed modifiers from the zone's list (shown on the briefing), telegraphs 30% shorter.
